wallets.name: swiyu Wallet
wallets.description:
swiyu is Switzerland’s open-source public digital wallet for trusted verifiable credentials and the national e-ID. 
Built by the Swiss Confederation and backed by a legal basis approved by Swiss voters, it combines state-backed trust with privacy and security by design. Selective disclosure and unlinkability keep people in control of what they share, while open standards and a pioneering architecture enable an interoperable ecosystem of public and private services. Developed together with government, business and civil society, swiyu is voluntary, accessible by design and built on a simple principle: public money, public code — with no proprietary lock-in and no business model on your data.
features: QR-Code scanning for reader engagement flow in proximity scenarios using Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) for device-to-device communications.

wallets.description: Generic issuer component of the SWIYU ecosystem, enabling organizations to issue verifiable credentials to compatible wallets within the Swiss e-ID infrastructure.

wallets.description: Generic verifier component of the SWIYU ecosystem, enabling organizations to request and verify verifiable presentations from compatible wallets within the Swiss e-ID infrastructure.
